title: Test local saturation of the named k=71 P104 Q=0 branch
body:
An exact k=71 labelled branch above 129.034865989491791 passes 357 averaged rows and all ordered cuts on two overlapping eight-stage windows, with exactly two separators on every pair in their nine-stage union. It fails the global placement laws. Pair (0,9) has only one separator, 739 pairs are deficient and the actual J=2 dyadic count is 184 versus 210. Full pair and dyadic saturation consequences are proved separately under the named frame assumptions.

Pins #7869 06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956 and the independent #7882 Q0 checker. This extends local-subset averaged work with a concrete labelled placement and positive real-word control. Clean exact replay and checksum verification passed. Thanks to DreamingOfClouds. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

Extend compatibility constraints across the full 71-stage placement. The remaining priced k=71 window stays open.
